title: 17 October 2026 Current Affairs
meta_title: 17 October 2026 Current Affairs: Easy English Questions & Answers
meta_description: Read 10 simple English questions on India's space economy, KONKAN-26, biodiversity, Project Seabird and Ayurveda, using official 17 October updates.

questions.q: What size could India's space economy reach in the next seven to eight years, according to the 17 October update?
questions.answer: USD 40–45 billion. This is a future estimate, not its present value.

questions.q: What was the current value of India's space economy stated in that update?
Which two countries took part in the KONKAN-26 naval exercise?
questions.answer: India and the United Kingdom. Their navies trained together.

questions.q: Which Indian Navy ship took part in KONKAN-26?
questions.answer: INS Trishul. The exercise ended off Plymouth, UK, on 15 October; PIB reported it on 17 October.

questions.q: At which naval base were new Project Seabird Phase IIA facilities opened?
questions.answer: Karwar Naval Base. The facilities were opened on 15 October and reported on 17 October.

questions.q: Which authority announced about Rs 1.19 crore for biodiversity boards and a UT council on 17 October?
questions.answer: The National Biodiversity Authority, or NBA. The money is under the Access and Benefit Sharing mechanism.

questions.q: How many State Biodiversity Boards received money in that NBA announcement?
questions.answer: 29 State Biodiversity Boards, along with one Union Territory Biodiversity Council.

questions.q: Which Ayurveda institute marked its 10th Foundation Day during KAUMARACON 2026?
questions.answer: The All India Institute of Ayurveda, or AIIA, in New Delhi.

questions.q: What area of healthcare did KAUMARACON 2026 focus on?
questions.answer: Ayurvedic child healthcare. The conference discussed education, research and care for children.

questions.q: Which two youth networks led the Yoga and Self-Defence Day activities reported on 17 October?
questions.answer: MY Bharat and the National Service Scheme, or NSS. The activities took place on 16 October under the Nasha Mukt Yuva campaign.

title: 18 October 2026 Current Affairs
meta_title: 18 October 2026 Current Affairs: Easy English Questions & Answers
meta_description: Learn 10 easy English current-affairs Q&A from official 18 October updates on SCO, INS Sudarshini, AI healthcare, purple potato and trout farming.

questions.q: Who was announced as India's representative at the 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting?
questions.answer: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh. The meeting was scheduled for 19–20 October 2026.

questions.q: Which city was to host that SCO meeting on 19–20 October 2026?
questions.answer: Dushanbe, the capital of Tajikistan. SCO means Shanghai Cooperation Organisation.

questions.q: Which Indian Navy sail training ship left Salalah, Oman, during Lokayan-2026?
questions.answer: INS Sudarshini. Its port visit ran from 14 to 17 October; the departure was reported on 18 October.

questions.q: Where was the Tech Conclave on AI for Health and Assistive Technologies held?
questions.answer: At IIT BHU in Varanasi. It was organised by STPI and the institute's Centre for Innovation, Incubation and Entrepreneurship.

questions.q: Which ministry oversees Software Technology Parks of India, or STPI?
questions.answer: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, also called MeitY.

questions.q: How many years of Namo Bharat operations were marked at Namo Bharat Diwas 2026?
questions.answer: Three years. The event was held on 17 October in New Delhi and reported on 18 October.

questions.q: What is the name of the purple-fleshed potato highlighted in the 18 October PIB backgrounder?
questions.answer: Kufri Jamunia. It was released in 2024; the 18 October 2026 article explains its features.

questions.q: Which research institute developed Kufri Jamunia and other nutrient-rich coloured potatoes?
questions.answer: ICAR–Central Potato Research Institute, or ICAR-CPRI.

questions.q: In which state is the Munsyari coldwater fisheries area reviewed on 18 October located?
Which fish is farmed in Munsyari's coldwater streams, according to that official update?
questions.answer: Rainbow trout. The update describes how trout farming supports local farmers' incomes.
